verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows LocalAI distributed as a Docker image (`docker run ... localai/localai:latest`) and described as 'one binary', but nothing documents installation through a standard package manager such as Homebrew, apt, pip, or npm. A container image pull is a different distribution method, not a package-manager install, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
